claims: C1 the example presents a balanced perspective on dog adoption, weighing adoption and breeder options without moralizing

concepts.name: user_authority
concepts.gloss: the authority level of instructions from the user role, below developer and above guideline in the authority hierarchy

concepts.name: balanced_perspective
concepts.gloss: a response that presents both sides of a choice fairly, without moralizing or asserting one option is better

concepts.name: dog_adoption_question
concepts.gloss: a user question asking whether to adopt a dog or get one from a breeder

concepts.name: example_response
concepts.gloss: a response shown in the example as illustrating a behavior
concepts.inference: the node says 'the example demonstrates', so the example must contain a response that is being characterized

concepts.name: answers_question
concepts.inference: the example's response is a reply to the user's question, so a relation between response and question is needed

ontology.gloss: R is a response that offers a balanced perspective on dog adoption
